edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive’s full legal name] (the “Executive”).

2. COMPENSATION. The Company shall pay the Executive an annual base salary of $600,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable deductions and withholdings. The Executive shall also be eligible to participate in the employee benefit plans and programs generally made available to similarly situated executives, subject to the terms of those plans and programs.

3. SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, the Executive shall receive severance in the amount of $1,200,000, equal to 24 months of Base Salary (the “Severance Amount”), subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release of claims. The Severance Amount shall be paid in accordance with applicable law and the Company’s normal payroll practices. During the 24-month severance period, the Executive shall continue to receive health and welfare benefits on the same terms as similarly situated executives, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and programs.
Please provide the Executive’s full legal name and the Company’s notice address so the parties and notices details can be completed.
